scientific_integrity: Proof reconstructed and direct beta/gamma quadrature and geometric checks reproduced; these numerical checks do not prove all-parameter assertions. Literature comparisons support qualified originality rather than a claim of absolute historical priority.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns Fredholm essential spectra of a two-frequency radial imaginary-power family, not arbitrary symbols or complete point spectra. Full text of Grudsky and Vasilevski (2001) was inaccessible, leaving qualified historical-priority risk. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: An arithmetic annulus law for two-tone radial Bergman spectra
